content.description: Add the 'integrity' attribute to the tag with a base64-encoded cryptographic hash of the external resource. This ensures the browser verifies the file's contents before executing it. Reference OWASP Top 10 A04:2021 - Insecure Design and OWASP ASVS 3.1.2 for secure resource loading.
